caption:
Chloe here, just letting the spring breeze catch the thin strap and take it easy. Sun’s been so kind to my skin lately, and this little café corner feels like the perfect place to linger over something sweet and really soak up the freedom. Honestly, I’m just here for the views, the vibe, and the occasional playful glance. 🌸☕ 
#SpringGetaway #TravelDiaries
